title: GOD'S PLAN
FOR YOUR FUTURE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: soft golden sunrise over misty forest
dew drops on morning grass close up
birds flying over horizon at dawn
slow motion clouds at golden hour

scenes.a: The heavy uncertainty weighing on your chest right now is seen by the Creator of light.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.
Lord, anchor my restless thoughts in the truth that you are already holding my coming days.
When the path ahead feels shrouded in fog, remind me that you are the author of every step.
Grant me the courage to surrender my need for control and simply walk in your light today.
May your peace fill my soul, silencing every doubt, as I trust in your unfailing goodness now.
